$comment: Command rules for the runtime agent. core merges these into the per-run settings file (core/src/agent/settings.ts). Anything not allowed is denied (dontAsk mode); the deny list is a second line for commands that must never run, even if a broader allow is added later. The agent has no GitHub access: core prefetches PR data into the run directory, so every gh command is denied. Read-only shell utilities (cat, head, tail, wc, ls, nl, sed -n, grep, cut, sort, uniq, tr, echo, cd; not find, which can -exec or -delete) are allowed because the agent reaches for them in chained commands; the sandbox still confines what they read and write, and Claude Code checks every part of a chained command.
